claims.text: The hotel is a few steps from the Spanish Steps, the Trevi Fountain and Villa Borghese.

findings.quote: Positioned in the heart of Rome, few steps from Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain, Villa Borghese.

claims.text: Villa La Cupola is set across two floors.

findings.quote: Set across two floors, it combines breathtaking city views with sumptuous interiors.

claims.text: All bathrooms feature Italian polychrome marble.

findings.quote: All the bathrooms in our Rome accommodations feature Italian polychrome marble.

claims.text: The Imperial Suite has Louis XVI and Piedmontese furnishings and a genuine Aubusson carpet.

findings.quote: Louis XVI and Piedmontese furnishings complement the wine red, gold, and green colour scheme, while a genuine Aubusson carpet lies underfoot

claims.text: The Veneto Suites are on the corner of the facade, under the hotel's cupola.

findings.quote: Our three Veneto Suites are situated on the corner of the façade under the Cupola of the hotel.

claims.text: The Cardinale cocktail was created at the hotel's bar and is still served at Orvm Bar.

findings.quote: The Cardinale was created at the Hotel Excelsior in 1950, when a cardinal suggested a new combination of ingredients to the bartender.
continues to be served at Or
findings.note: still served at Orvm Bar (text wraps)

claims.text: Doney hosts a Sunday Brunch with live stations, desserts and free-flow Italian sparkling wine.

findings.quote: On Sundays, enjoy Doney’s Sunday Brunch with live stations, desserts and free-flow Italian sparkling wine.

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor pool.

findings.quote: We have a small indoor pool, sauna and massage center
In-room Spa: Relax and revitalize in the comfort and privacy of your room with our in-room signature treatments

claims.text: Villa La Cupola sits on the hotel's rooftop, with private terraces and panoramas over Rome.

findings.quote: Located on the hotel’s rooftop, Villa La Cupola features private terraces ideal for intimate escapes or unforgettable events, with stunning panoramas over the Eternal City.

claims.text: Villa La Cupola's domed living room is crowned by a frescoed cupola inspired by Renaissance and Baroque Rome.

findings.quote: At the heart of the suite is the majestic domed living room, crowned by a frescoed cupola inspired by Renaissance and Baroque Rome.

claims.text: Villa La Cupola has a Pompeian-style Jacuzzi pool with a mosaic floor, vaulted ceiling and frescoes evoking ancient Roman baths.

findings.quote: a magnificent Pompeian-style Jacuzzi pool, adorned with a mosaic floor, vaulted ceiling, and frescoes that evoke the ambiance of ancient Roman baths

claims.text: The hotel is on Via Veneto, between the Spanish Steps and the Borghese Gardens and Gallery.

findings.quote: located on Via Veneto, our 5-star hotel in Rome enjoys a privileged setting between the Spanish Steps and the Borghese Gardens and Gallery

claims.text: Rooms have rich furnishings in Empire or Biedermeier style, with damasks in red, green or beige.

findings.quote: Rich furnishings in Empire or Biedermeier style with damasks in shades of red, green or beige.

claims.text: Four people are not allowed in one room; a second room must be booked.

findings.quote: 4 people in the room are not allowed even if a SNA has been confirmed and a second room shall be booked.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the historic building may have varying room sizes.
